signals.summary: Reco opens new office in Texas and expands internationally to the United Kingdom and Ireland
signals.evidence: To support customer growth, Reco is opening a physical office in Texas, where it already maintains employees and serves enterprise customers. Reco is also expanding internationally with a dedicated team in the United Kingdom and Ireland.

signals.summary: Reco partners with a key U.S. channel reseller
signals.evidence: The company said it has achieved top national reseller rankings with a key U.S. channel partner that has developed a managed security services practice built around Reco’s platform.

signals.summary: Reco received three Global InfoSec Awards 2026
signals.evidence: The company recently received three Global InfoSec Awards for 2026, including recognition in SaaS and cloud security, AI security solutions and generative AI cybersecurity categories.

signals.summary: Reco offers an AI security platform focused on discovering, governing and securing AI agents, identities and SaaS connections
signals.evidence: Reco, which provides an AI security platform focused on discovering, governing and securing AI agents, identities and SaaS connections.

signals.summary: Reco’s platform uses a knowledge graph architecture to map identities, permissions, connectivity and activity in real time
signals.evidence: The company’s platform uses a knowledge graph architecture to map identities, permissions, connectivity and activity across enterprise environments in real time.

signals.summary: Reco’s platform supports more than 235 applications and over 1,000 detection controls
signals.evidence: The platform supports more than 235 applications and includes more than 1,000 detection controls designed to identify security and governance risks.
